brief: A TikTok Live shopping brand for recognisable makeup, skincare and haircare. It should feel like a real beauty brand first: bold, premium and social-native, never cheap or like a discount store.
criteria: Success: loud on TikTok Live, recognisable as a 48 px profile picture, works in one colour, sits naturally next to Sephora and Ulta brands.

concepts.name: Beauty Rush Bold
concepts.idea: Heavy black capitals on candy pink: simple, loud and instantly recognisable on a TikTok Live.
rationale: Type-only wordmark in the spirit of the big beauty houses: confident, no clip-art
Candy pink and black own the feed and read at a glance on Live graphics
BR monogram carries the brand where the full name is too small

recommendation: Use the horizontal logo as the main logo, the stacked logo on packaging and merch, and the BR monogram for the TikTok profile picture and icons.
